title: PBKDF2-SHA384/SHA512 test vector header files
description: Create tests/vectors/pbkdf2_sha384.h and tests/vectors/pbkdf2_sha512.h with known-answer test vectors from OpenSSL/pyca external oracles. Struct layout must match existing pbkdf2_sha256.h pattern (password, password_len, salt, salt_len, iterations, dk_len, dk, source). Three vectors each: TC1 iter=1000 salt=saltsaltsaltsalt, TC2 iter=4096 salt=saltSALTsalt..., TC3 iter=2000 salt=deadbeefdeadbeef. All vectors verified against both OpenSSL and pyca/cryptography.
